I'll keep debugging but you might find out faster than me.

@rndquu Long story short, I had `yarn link` on `rpc-handler` into `permit-generation` that I was linking against `conversation-rewards` which was using broken code. I runs great and I could generate a [permit](https://pay.ubq.fi?).
